name: WittyBluray
summary: Blu-ray images with their menus, including 4K, HDR and 3D discs.
updates: Playing an open disc: reading its playlists and clips, running its program, reading its menus and subtitles.
stays: Finding and describing discs in a library scan, the check that refuses encrypted discs, drawing menus, turning a disc's steps into what the player shows, and discs with Java menus when Java menus are turned on: the built-in copy plays those. The server also opens every disc itself first, so a disc it can't read at all needs a new server.
needs: FFmpeg, which comes with the server
Java, only for discs with Java menus, and only if you turn that on
